speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The history of position-dependent spinning vertigo in a 70-year-old without other neurological deficits is classic for this condition. I recommend the Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis.
